text: The universe began with a huge explosion.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.note: 2012 survey; older data. 39% answered correctly (true). NSF reports the share answering correctly; don’t-know is counted on the wrong side.

truthSource.label: NASA, Big Bang
truthSource.oneLine: Cosmic expansion and the microwave background record a hot, dense beginning about 13.8 billion years ago.

lesson.tip: “Big Bang” is a nickname. A claim in everyday words can be true even if an expert would phrase it more precisely.
